北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，早晚添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has haze, wear a mask and layer up in mornings and evenings!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感13℃，注意保暖别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and cool, feels like 13℃, keep warm to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感15℃。早晚温差大，别忘添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 15℃. Big temperature difference, remember to add layers.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天潮湿，体感舒适，记得带伞防小雨。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and humid, feels comfortable. Bring an umbrella for light rain.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天湿润，体感22℃。记得多喝水保持活力！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and moist, feels like 22℃. Stay hydrated and energetic!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴凉，体感15℃。穿暖暖，小心感冒哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cool and overcast, feels like 15℃. Dress warmly, watch out for colds!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云风大，体感13℃。记得多穿点，别被风吹凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy, feels like 13℃. Dress warmly, don't get chilled by the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感19℃。湿度适中，记得带伞哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 19℃. Moderate humidity, remember to bring an umbrella!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility, please drive slowly.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感15℃。早晚微凉，注意添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Slightly cool in mornings/evenings, add layers.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆雾气浓，湿度高。驾车慢行，注意安全哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is very foggy and humid. Drive slowly, stay safe.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾，体感-2℃。天寒地冻，注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has haze, feels like -2℃. It's freezing cold, keep warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感7℃。气温较低，记得添厚衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 7℃. It's quite cool, remember to wear warm clothes.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感16℃。早晚温差大，适当加衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 16℃. Big temperature difference, add appropriate layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雨，体感13℃。出门带伞，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has rain, feels like 13℃. Bring an umbrella, keep warm and sheltered from wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感6℃。大雾降温，注意添衣慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like 6℃. Fog causes cooling, dress warmly and drive slowly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感6℃。有点凉，别忘多穿衣服哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast, feels like 6℃. It's a bit chilly, remember to wear more clothes!
